limits: The current client retains obsolete descriptions; these cannot override the explicit publisher replacement.
Concentrated Boss Aura752014 (Heating for Blackstar) remains distinct from Contained Boss Aura8917 (Simple Alchemy for Jetina).
No saved identities or inventory quantities are converted; no conversion rate or automatic equipment salvage is added.
Current generic sources are qualified; boss-specific drop probabilities and exhaustive sources remain outside this correction.
